summary: All 5 acceptance criteria independently verified via live build and command execution.
npm run build: tsup compiled both entry points (index, changelog/index) to dual CJS+ESM+DTS output. dist/changelog/index.{js,cjs,d.ts,d.cts} paths match the exports map exactly.

comments.note: prebuild script uses require('fs') in node -e while package.json has "type": "module". This works because node -e evaluates as CJS by default, but could confuse contributors. Low-priority — the build is correct and functional.
tsup emits 'Generated an empty chunk: index' warnings for both entry points. This is expected behavior for stub modules that only export {}. No action needed.

summary: Reviewed all 8 scaffold files. No blocking issues found. Architecture is clean, consistent, and follows the ai-persona-builder conventions exactly as intended.
moduleResolution:bundler confirmed correct for tsup/esbuild — resolves the QA flag. Extension-less imports work, ESM/CJS interop is handled by tsup at build time.
Exports map ordering (types→import→require) is correct: TypeScript resolvers honour declaration order and pick up 'types' first.
prebuild script uses require() in node -e: functionally correct because node -e always runs in CJS context regardless of package type:module. No fix needed.
Minor redundancy: prebuild cleans dist/ and tsup clean:true also cleans dist/ — dist is deleted twice on npm run build. Harmless, no action required.
Two documentation-forward items captured for the Documentation agent.

comments.note: prebuild script and tsup clean:true both delete dist/ before building — dist is cleaned twice on npm run build. Harmless redundancy; if the prebuild script is removed in future, tsup's clean:true already covers the clean step.
